review_method: Early, middle and late contact frames; composed frame inspections; moving excerpts checked after final render.

factory_close.observed: Foreman at locked factory gate; three workers carrying lunch pails walk away.

bank_queue.observed: Orderly queue of period-dressed depositors outside a bank-like stone entrance. Generated sign lettering is indistinct and is not evidence.

exchange.observed: Period trading floor, desk telephones, paper records and brokers; no modern digital displays.

planning.observed: Two developers reviewing an office plan beside calculator and an ordinary office building model.

budget.observed: Finance analyst checking folders, calculator, site drawings, material samples and a model.

signature.observed: Bank desk pen handover, contract signature and document return. Clear signing action.

tenant_visit.observed: Letting representative with folder and two prospective business tenants inspect a usable office and desk layout.

growth.observed: Active company office with manager welcoming new employees among occupied desks.

lease_competition.observed: Two corporate visitors compare office models and brochures while agents present competing offers in the same showroom.

sites.observed: Four distinct mid-rise concrete office projects, separate crane groups and access areas in one district; full source frame retained to keep cranes visible.

investors.observed: Three business participants discuss one site model and several finance folders, with each participant responding to the same project assumptions.

tourism.observed: Visitors taking photographs and using binoculars on an observation deck, illustrating actual tourist use distinct from office leasing.

cancel_order.observed: Manager ends a desk-phone call, puts down the handset and closes the expansion-plan folder beside unopened equipment boxes.

contraction.observed: Office staff remove computers and chairs; a smaller floor plan is carried through the increasingly empty desk area.

departure.observed: Employees carry boxes out of the leased office; the property representative remains holding the returned keys beside the vacated room.

vacancy.observed: Many unused desk positions remain around a small group of occupants, while two representatives compare a lease folder. This is reduced occupancy, not an entirely abandoned floor.

refinance.observed: Developer compares separate old and new loan folders with a calculator as the bank officer points to the proposal. Exact rates and cash amounts are supplied by the compositor.

valuation.observed: Two inspectors check an unoccupied office using a handheld measuring device, floor records and photographs of the units.

credit.observed: Bank employee returns the application papers across the desk; the workshop owner collects the folder and listens with concern.

sample.observed: Overhead view clearly expands two selected building photographs into a broad grid of additional cases and records.

precommit.observed: Researchers write and set aside the checklist before opening the separate case-record folder. Printed marks remain illustrative rather than claimed statistical evidence.

stress.observed: Financial reviewer sets aside one sheet, recalculates with a desk calculator and points to the revised budget while the developer follows.

ledger.observed: Overhead view links rental records, a paper calendar and the calculator; the accountant circles calendar cells and checks the ledger. Generated calendar lettering is not treated as factual data.

esb_motion.observed: Generated architecture and skyline diverge from supplied photograph.
esb_motion.final_replacement: Verified Empire State Building whole-building photograph, animated by compositor.

burj_motion.observed: Generated tower lacks accurate complete taper and full-building framing.
burj_motion.final_replacement: Verified SOM Burj Khalifa whole-building photograph, animated by compositor.

reviewed_compositions: Factory departure full photographic frame with charcoal paper surround.
Loan signing and exact 600-million / 4-percent / 24-million annual-interest annotations.
Burj Khalifa real silhouette and Dubai World event date separated.
PETRONAS true twin towers and skybridge, 1992-to-1999 planning timeline.
Research bibliographic record using verified title, authors, DOI and publication details.
